rationale: Record that the nightly cross-platform check's Linux legs now call tools/ci/install_visual_python_deps.sh, the same script build.yml and sanitizers.yml already call, so the non-skippable visual-python-deps-present ctest is answerable there; tools/scripts/test_visual_python_deps_step.py lists the nightly among the jobs that must call it. The installed set, its hash pinning and the interpreter resolution are unchanged. No visual harness fixture, golden, threshold, capture path, renderer, importer or Vellum-owned source changes, and no design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
